results.compiled_code:
select
    vendor_id,
    payment_type,
    pickup_ts,
    dropoff_ts,
    total_amount,
    fare_amount,
    tip_amount,
    trip_distance,
    passenger_count,
    pickup_location_id,
    dropoff_location_id,

    cast(pickup_ts as date) as pickup_date,
    date_part('hour', pickup_ts) as pickup_hour,

    round(datediff('second', pickup_ts, dropoff_ts) / 60.0, 2) as trip_duration_min,

    case
        when fare_amount > 0 then tip_amount / fare_amount
        else 0.0
    end as tip_rate,

    case
        when trip_distance > 0 then fare_amount / trip_distance
        else 0.0
    end as fare_per_mile

from TAXIOPS_DB.RAW.taxi_trips_silver

select
    pickup_date,
    payment_type,
    count(*) as total_trips,
    round(sum(total_amount), 2) as total_revenue,
    round(avg(fare_amount), 2) as avg_fare_amount,
    round(avg(tip_rate), 4) as avg_tip_rate
from TAXIOPS_DB.PUBLIC_STAGING.stg_taxi_trips_silver
group by pickup_date, payment_type
order by pickup_date, payment_type

select
    pickup_date,
    vendor_id,
    count(*) as total_trips,
    round(sum(total_amount), 2) as total_revenue,
    round(avg(trip_distance), 2) as avg_trip_distance,
    round(avg(fare_per_mile), 2) as avg_fare_per_mile,
    round(max(total_amount), 2) as max_trip_total
from TAXIOPS_DB.PUBLIC_STAGING.stg_taxi_trips_silver
group by pickup_date, vendor_id
order by pickup_date, vendor_id

select
    pickup_date,
    pickup_hour,
    count(*) as total_trips,
    round(sum(total_amount), 2) as total_revenue,
    round(avg(fare_amount), 2) as avg_fare_amount,
    round(avg(tip_amount), 2) as avg_tip_amount,
    round(avg(trip_distance), 2) as avg_trip_distance,
    round(avg(trip_duration_min), 2) as avg_trip_duration_min
from TAXIOPS_DB.PUBLIC_STAGING.stg_taxi_trips_silver
group by pickup_date, pickup_hour
order by pickup_date, pickup_hour

args.invocation_command: dbt run --select stg_taxi_trips_silver hourly_kpis payment_kpis vendor_kpis
